constraints: must be broadcast-compatible with x2 if axis is None
must be broadcast-compatible with x1 if axis is None

axis.description: Axis along which tensor `x2` is appended to tensor `x1`. If `None`, both tensors are flattened before use.
constraints: if specified, both tensors must have compatible shapes
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes if axis is None

output.description: A tensor with the values of `x2` appended to `x1`.
